rule: An excursion is two or more consecutive valid readings strictly above 5.0°C. A single isolated reading above 5.0°C surrounded by normal (or missing-boundary) readings is a spike, not an alert. ERR and other invalid values are skipped and break a run. A gap longer than the 15-minute sampling interval also breaks a run. Duration is (end - start) in minutes, i.e. from the first to the last consecutive reading above the threshold, not until the first reading back at or below 5.0. Times are Asia/Jerusalem local, with no timezone offset. Fahrenheit loggers are converted to °C from the value as it appears in the file (one decimal place).
